notes.title: Update v240929A
notes.content:
ADDED: Bare feet option in character customization
ADDED: Freelook camera (activate by holding Left Alt)
ADDED: Weather options are now saved

FIXED: Always run not working after the first attack
FIXED: Player was able to kick boss enemies if damage cam was active

notes.title: Update v240414A
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42976544/9427bf25d501614e237d99c8f44a1abc6c919976.jpg[/img]

NEW FEATURE: Damage cam. 

Shows bone breaking kicks with x-ray style and slow motion. With kick skill upgraded to the max you can use optional damage camera to show how bones of your enemies get smashed into pieces.


[u]Other changes/fixes:[/u]

ADDED: Slider in options menu to adjust damage cam probability

+Couple of general improvements
